sentences.text:
At the outset, learned counsel for the petitioner submits that he has not deposited penalty of Rs.75,000/- imposed upon him as per Section 76 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006,
therefore, he prays for time to deposit the same.
Let the said amount be deposited by the appellant within a period of four weeks.
List the case after four weeks.

(AVANINDRA KUMAR SINGH) JUDGE rahul Anil Kumar Rajpoot vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 21 December, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/62901981/
